$description: ComparisonView (platform/patterns/ComparisonView, library wave 9, lane B): its component tokens. The panes are framed like the other panels (border, surface radius); the badges, switch, segmented control, table and slider keep their own tokens. No new color: existing roles.

comparison-view-gap.$description: Comparison view: the space between the bar and the panes (or the table, or the slider).

comparison-view-bar-gap.$description: Comparison view: the space between the count and the controls, and between the controls.

comparison-view-bar-row-gap.$description: Comparison view: the space between the bar's lines when it wraps.

comparison-view-summary-text.$description: Comparison view: the count of differences.

comparison-view-summary-line-height.$description: Comparison view: the count's line height.

comparison-view-pane-gap.$description: Comparison view: the space between two panes (side by side, or stacked).

comparison-view-pane-border-color.$description: Comparison view: a pane's frame and the line under its head.

comparison-view-pane-border-width.$description: Comparison view: a pane's frame width.

comparison-view-pane-radius.$description: Comparison view: a pane's corners, and the slider's stage's.

comparison-view-pane-padding-block.$description: Comparison view: a pane body's top and bottom padding.

comparison-view-pane-padding-inline.$description: Comparison view: a pane's start and end padding (head and body).

comparison-view-head-padding-block.$description: Comparison view: a pane head's top and bottom padding.

comparison-view-head-gap.$description: Comparison view: the space between a pane's name and its version or date.

comparison-view-title-text.$description: Comparison view: a pane's name (its heading).

comparison-view-title-font-family.$description: Comparison view: a pane's name is UI text: the label font.

comparison-view-title-font-size.$description: Comparison view: a pane's name's size.

comparison-view-title-font-weight.$description: Comparison view: a pane's name's weight.

comparison-view-title-line-height.$description: Comparison view: a pane's name's line height.

comparison-view-meta-text.$description: Comparison view: a pane's version or date under its name.

comparison-view-meta-font-family.$description: Comparison view: versions and dates are technical values: the data font (Reddit Mono).

comparison-view-meta-font-size.$description: Comparison view: the version or date's size.

comparison-view-meta-line-height.$description: Comparison view: the version or date's line height.

comparison-view-body-gap.$description: Comparison view: the space between a pane's preview, content and attributes; and around the slider's stage.

comparison-view-scroll-height.$description: Comparison view (scroll): the tallest a pane's body grows before it scrolls, with the others.

comparison-view-focus-border-color.$description: Comparison view (scroll): a pane's frame while its scrolling body has the keyboard focus.

comparison-view-row-gap.$description: Comparison view: the space between two attributes.

comparison-view-row-inner-gap.$description: Comparison view: the space between an attribute's label and its value, and inside a value that wraps.

comparison-view-label-font-size.$description: Comparison view: an attribute's label's size.

comparison-view-label-line-height.$description: Comparison view: an attribute's label's line height.

comparison-view-value-font-size.$description: Comparison view: an attribute's value's size.

comparison-view-value-line-height.$description: Comparison view: an attribute's value's line height.

comparison-view-value-gap.$description: Comparison view: the space between a value and its Changed badge.

comparison-view-data-font-family.$description: Comparison view: values of a data attribute (sizes, dates, IDs) in the data font.

comparison-view-stage-background.$description: Comparison view (slider): the stage behind the pictures while they load.

comparison-view-divider-color.$description: Comparison view (slider): the line between before and after, in the surface color.

comparison-view-divider-width.$description: Comparison view (slider): the line's width (it does not scale with the picture).
